grammar.title: 语法知识 need的详细用法
lines: 5 mustn't 与 needn't
实义 动词 需要助动词do 情态 动词 使用need去处理否定、疑问
真实表达 虚拟表达 (过去已发生无力回天)
need sth. You need some time. need do Need I go to the meeting? need have done 需要过去应该做某事(但事实上没有做)
need sb. The baby needs mom. needn't do No, you needn't ( go to the meeting). needn't have done 需要过去不做(但事实上已做了)
need to do He needs to have a rest. 需要做就去做，真实可以办到的。 不需要做就不做，也可以做到。 过去应该做结果没有做，现在做来不及了。 过去不应该做，结果做了，现在后悔也不行了。
need sb. to do I don't need friends to help me.
need doing Her bag needs mending.
Must I finish my homework today?
mustn't 禁止(语气强) needn't 、don't need to 不需要(语气温和)
Yes, you must . No, you needn't. 不需要完成作业
No, you mustn't. 禁止完成作业 No, you don't. 不需要完成作
原型 (Base Form) 过去式 (Past Tense) 过去分词 (Past Participle)
wear wore worn

expand.title: 扩展知识 Must, Have (got) to and Need
lines: 4 Must （必须，不得不） Need （需要） 每日习语 Leave no stone unturned 竭尽全力；想方设法
must 用于表示推测 must + do 现在和将来的推测 must be doing 正在发生的事情的推测 must have done 对过去的推测 must have been doing 过去正在发生的事情的推测
一般疑问句 Must I set off now? 通常不用 mustn’t 回答 Yes, you must / have to. No, you needn’t. 回答 must/have to 或 needn’t
mustn't （不能、不准）表示绝对禁止，在说话人看来，根本没选择余地 You mustn’t use that bicycle. “不必要”可用 needn’t It’s broken.
needn’t 不必（情态） = don’t have to (实义) You needn’t / don’t have to work such long hours. need I...? (情态) / Do I need...? 实义动词

Need I go out? = Do I need to go out? 做为实义动词时连接其它动词后面加 to do Need you leave so soon? need 用于疑问句时，问者往往希望得到否定的回答(肯定句用 must，have to，ought to 或 should) Yes, you must 回答可以用 must/had to . / No, you needn’t . 否定形式的回答可以用 needn’t Need you have told him about my plans? Yes, I had to. / No, I needn’t have. Need I type this letter again? I must go to the dentist this moring. 表示必要时，must 的语气比need 要强
didn’t have to = needn’t have done He needn’t follow me . 情态动词后面不能直接用名词做宾语 A doesn’t need B needn’t to C didn’t need to D needs. You needn’t have told me that. I know it is. 情态动词 need 后接动词原形

I needn’t have gone to the office yesterday. (完成式)表示说话人让对方选择或允许对方可以不做某事的主观意图 I didn’t have to / didn’t need to go to the office yesterday. 过去式 mustn't VS. needn't → You musn’t read it bed. It’s bad for your eyes.

need doing sth. 用主动表达被动含义 这里 need 属于实义动词, 动词 ing 相当于名词来理解 有时态和人称变化,否定式为: don’t need doing need doing 表达被动含义, 如: Your shoes need washing. 你的鞋子需(被)洗了 Your hair needs cuting. want doing 用主动表示被动含义(主语一定是物)
need to be done (主语：人、物) The child need to be …

be bad for… 对…有害 Smoking is bad for your health. 抽烟有害你的健康 You mustn't make a noise. The children are asleep. 你不应吵闹, 孩子们都睡了 You needn't drive so quickly. We have plenty of time. 你不必开得那么快, 我们有足够的时间 =You don't have to(haven't got to) drive so quickly. We have plenty of time. You mustn't smoke in a theatre. It is forbidden. 你不应该在剧场里抽烟, 这是不允许的 You needn't come with us if you don't want to. 如果你不想去, 你不必和我们一道去 =You don't have to (haven't got to) come with us if you don't want to.
